rawContent: As a #spoonie I absolutely am the worst ableist towards my own body and my inability to practice law and make a difference in this world with my license. But the one thing I can do- speak up on social media without worrying about losing clients. #BlackLivesMatter #disability

Just to be clear @MarshaBlackburn and @SenAlexander if you are not hearing from us Tennesseans about #BlackLivesMatter issues, it’s not because we don’t care. It’s that we have zero evidence you will ever take our concerns into consideration in your votes. #TN @NashvilleResist
